entry.content:
• Promoted gcloud apigee apis import to GA. The command imports an API proxy from a YAML template (--from-template) or from a proxy bundle ZIP (--from-bundle).
  • Fixed an issue where gcloud apigee apis import --from-template emitted an EventFlow inside the generic <Flows> container, where Apigee treats it as an ordinary conditional flow instead of running it on each streamed event. EventFlow is now emitted as a top-level element carrying a content-type attribute, which defaults to text/event-stream, and is preserved when importing a bundle.
  • Fixed an issue where gcloud apigee apis import --from-template applied only part of a feature's defaultEndpoint. Its routes and faultRules were dropped, and a flow step contributed by two features was emitted twice, which made Apigee run the policy twice. Contributions are now merged, so a repeated step overrides instead of duplicating.
  • Fixed an issue where gcloud apigee apis import --from-template ignored a feature's defaultTarget, so generated target endpoints were missing the PostFlow, EventFlow and DefaultFaultRule it declared. Features that attach to the outbound side of a proxy, such as analytics and failover, now apply to every target. This can make the generated API proxy an Extensible API proxy, which can't be deployed to a Base environment.
  • Fixed an issue where gcloud apigee apis import --from-template prefixed a feature's policy and resource names even when the feature declared no uid. A feature with no name produced an empty prefix and names that collided with every other unnamed feature. Names are now prefixed only for features that declare a uid, and policies or resources contributed by more than one feature are merged instead of listed twice. This changes the policy names generated for features without a uid.
  • Fixed an issue where gcloud apigee apis import --from-template combined a template's own endpoints and targets with the ones its features supply, which could leave some targets unreachable because no route referenced them. A template's endpoints and targets are now used only when it supplies no features, and a warning is logged when they are ignored.
  • Fixed an issue where gcloud apigee apis import --from-template did not generate apiproxy/resources/jsc/metadata.js, so feature JavaScript that read the proxy's name, description or parameter defaults failed at runtime. The resource is now generated into the bundle and listed in <Resources>.
  • Fixed an issue where gcloud apigee apis import --from-template emitted the children of a policy in alphabetical order rather than the order the template declared them, which is not valid for policies whose schema is sequence-typed. <HTTPTargetConnection> is now also emitted before the flows, regardless of how the target was declared.
  • Fixed an issue where gcloud apigee apis import --from-template would incorrectly reject templates that populate the displayName field.
  • Added --service-account flag to gcloud beta apigee apis deploy to give a deployed proxy permission to act as a service account.
entry.summary: The `gcloud apigee apis import` command is now generally available, offering improved API proxy creation from YAML templates or bundles. This release includes numerous fixes for template-based imports, ensuring accurate handling of event flows, default endpoints, targets, and resource naming, along with enhanced flexibility for service account permissions during deployment.
entry.title: Apigee: Apigee API Import GA

entry.content: • Added --service-type-enum-values and related flags to gcloud apihub apis update, allowing the service type of an API to be set. Valid values are code, model, agent and skill.
entry.summary: You can now update the service type for your APIs using the `gcloud apihub apis update` command. This command supports setting the service type to `code`, `model`, `agent`, or `skill` using the new `--service-type-enum-values` flag.
entry.title: Apihub: Update API service type

  • Promoted gcloud biglake hive databases to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud biglake hive tables to GA.
entry.summary: The BigLake Hive command-line interface (CLI) commands for catalogs, databases, and tables have been promoted to General Availability (GA). This means these features are now production-ready and available for use in your BigLake environments.

entry.content: • Added --key-algorithm flag to gcloud privateca certificates create to allow specifying a custom public key algorithm when creating certificates with --generate-key.
entry.summary: You can now specify a custom public key algorithm when creating certificates using the `--key-algorithm` flag with `gcloud privateca certificates create`. This flag works in conjunction with the `--generate-key` option.
entry.title: Certificate Authority Service: New flag for certificate creation

entry.title: Cloud Bigtable: Cloud Bigtable Go update

entry.title: Cloud Dataplex: Dataplex data products now generally available

entry.content: • Added gcloud iam workforce-pools subjects revoke-sessions command to revoke all sessions for a workforce pool subject.
entry.summary: A new command, `gcloud iam workforce-pools subjects revoke-sessions`, has been added. This command allows administrators to revoke all active sessions for a specific workforce pool subject, enhancing security and control over user access.
entry.title: Cloud IAM: Manage Workforce Pool Sessions

entry.content: • Migrate extraction library to osv-scalibr and enable dynamic linking support (2026-09).
entry.summary: The extraction library has been migrated to osv-scalibr, enhancing dynamic linking support. This update, scheduled for September 2026, aims to improve the efficiency and flexibility of on-demand scanning capabilities.
entry.title: Cloud On Demand Scanning: On-Demand Scanning Improvements

entry.content: • The --recommend flag of gcloud beta projects delete and gcloud beta projects remove-iam-policy-binding no longer has any effect; the change-risk recommendations it showed have been retired.
entry.summary: The `--recommend` flag for `gcloud beta projects delete` and `gcloud beta projects remove-iam-policy-binding` has been retired. The change-risk recommendations previously shown by this flag are no longer available.
entry.title: Cloud Resource Manager: Project deletion and IAM policy binding changes

entry.content:

  • Updated 'cloud-sql-proxy' packaged component to use 2.26.0 of the Cloud SQL Proxy.
entry.summary: New routing parameters are available for instance creation. The Cloud SQL Proxy has also been updated to version 2.26.0.
entry.title: Cloud SQL: Cloud SQL updates

entry.content: • Added networkTags property to --slurm-login-node flag in gcloud beta cluster-director clusters create.
entry.summary: The `gcloud beta cluster-director clusters create` command now supports the `networkTags` property for the `--slurm-login-node` flag. This allows for more granular control over network configurations for Slurm login nodes within your Cluster Director deployments.
entry.title: Cluster Director: New network tag option for Slurm login nodes

entry.content:
• Added support for reading a metadata value from standard input by specifying - as the file path in --metadata-from-file flag of gcloud compute instances create, gcloud compute instances add-metadata, gcloud compute instance-templates create, and gcloud compute project-info add-metadata.
  • Froze development of the alpha and beta Compute Engine release tracks. Existing commands in these release tracks remain supported and functional. Most previous alpha and beta features have graduated to general availability in gcloud compute, and new Compute Engine preview features will launch in gcloud preview compute going forward.
entry.summary: You can now read Compute Engine metadata from standard input using the gcloud CLI. Development has also shifted for alpha and beta release tracks, with new features launching in `gcloud preview compute`.
entry.title: Compute Engine: New Compute Engine Metadata Option

entry.content: • Added --description flag to gcloud compute os-config policy-orchestrators create and gcloud compute os-config policy-orchestrators update.
entry.summary: The OS Config service now supports a `--description` flag for creating and updating policy orchestrators. This allows for more detailed policy management.
entry.title: Compute OS Config: New OS Config Flag

entry.content:
• Added --ssl-flags flag to gcloud database-migration connection-profiles create postgresql and update commands to configure SSL connection flags.
  • Added --asm-host, --asm-port, --asm-user, --asm-password, and --asm-service-name flags to gcloud database-migration connection-profiles create oracle command to configure Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM).
  • Added --machine-type flag to gcloud database-migration connection-profiles create alloydb command to configure the primary instance machine type.
entry.summary: New flags have been added to the database migration command-line tool to enhance connection profile configuration for PostgreSQL, Oracle, and AlloyDB. These updates allow for more detailed SSL settings, Oracle ASM configuration, and primary instance machine type specification.
entry.title: Database Migration: Database Migration Enhancements

entry.content: • The --recommend flag of gcloud beta iam service-accounts delete no longer has any effect; the change-risk recommendations it showed have been retired.
entry.summary: The `--recommend` flag for deleting IAM service accounts has been retired as its change-risk recommendations are no longer available. This change means the flag will now have no effect on the command's execution.
entry.title: Identity and Access Management: IAM service account deletion changes
